other_failure_modes.name: Invalid Lambda Signature for Stdout
other_failure_modes.description: The agent overrides sys.stdout.flush with a lambda that requires one argument. Since flush() is called without arguments, this causes a TypeError when the system attempts to flush stdout, leading to a crash.
